customer_support_bot.name: Customer Support & Chatbot Looping
candidate_quotes: They always try to convert to another currency with inconvenient rate, I many times ticked "remember for future payments" and still sets the wrong currency by default.
The other day, tired of this, I cancelled the order and explained this very reason (wrong currency), and the transaction went through on its own!
The worst experience I had to wait for 1 hour and 45 mins for an order for a restaurant that is literally 3 mins away.
It kept on displaying 10 mins left for the last 1 hour.

delivery_delays_riders.name: Delivery Delays & Rider Operations
candidate_quotes: Then, check the time a few minutes later, you will notice that there is a discrepancy in the time that has passed since you placed the order and the actual delivery time.
As an experiment, check the time you place the order & the delivery time they initially mention.
They show you a certain time the food will reach in & then manipulate the time without you noticing.
When a company tries to fool its customers every time they order, it speaks volumes about their ethics & values.
